raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Advance `.main.commit` and the Megatron-LM gitlink from `3e95097b4a9ab6ea6b2a39eb2b2b24e4a6dfa54a` to `3914483fd325e053797aff3fa431d4a3141139aa`, the current Megatron-LM `main`. The dev pin is unchanged.

[Upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/3e95097b4a9ab6ea6b2a39eb2b2b24e4a6dfa54a...3914483fd325e053797aff3fa431d4a3141139aa) (4 commits, fast-forward): streamed-partial alignment after eviction in inference (#8150), kernel warmup from the model config (#7653), unified mHC and WR replay coordination (#7923), and the cuDNN Frontend install in the CI dev image (#8176). None of them touch dependency metadata, and `uv.lock` does not reference the pin, so it is unchanged.

Purpose: run the full L0/L1/L2 suite on H100 and GB200 against current `main` (which now includes Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B, #6483) at the latest MCore.
